title: Saalbach Hinterglemm Catalog Curation - scoped local owner and Skicircus extension
summary: Corrects PR #15 against the normalized catalog and schema-version-2 scope contract. The retained ski-area ID remains the Saalbach Hinterglemm weather owner; whole-Skicircus terrain, season, feature totals, and map claims are removed from that narrower owner. Hinterglemm is added as a sourced stay base with direct Reiterkogelbahn access, representative elevation, mixed development, lively pace, and destination-defining local apres. Leogang, Fieberbrunn, and the connected Skicircus terrain domain are explicitly deferred as one weather-owner migration, while Ski ALPIN CARD retains its official 408 km / 121-lift pass-accessible aggregate.

ranking_impact_summary: Hinterglemm adds one explicit stay-base and local-access configuration; existing calculation policy is unchanged.
unresolved_caveats: Local Saalbach Hinterglemm terrain totals and exact local season window remain unresolved because the reviewed 270 km, 70-lift, difficulty, and 2026/27 dates describe the wider Skicircus; the 2025/26 operating inventory exposes 42 local lift codes but does not publish that derived subtotal as a stable official metric.
The official trail map belongs to the complete Skicircus and is reserved for the deferred connected terrain domain rather than copied onto the local weather owner.
Glacier-terrain availability remains unknown: official material distinguishes Kitzsteinhorn as the separate glacier area, but does not explicitly establish a negative for the local owner.
Local snowmaking coverage, snowpark inventory, and marked freeride routes remain unresolved because reviewed official claims are scoped to the wider Skicircus.
Leogang, Fieberbrunn, their weather-owning ski areas and access edges, and the connected Skicircus terrain domain are deferred together through the catalog curation backlog.
Accommodation and rental price ranges and quality tiers remain product-curated estimates pending a reviewed sampling policy.
The Ski ALPIN CARD references the modeled Saalbach Hinterglemm local area directly until the complete Skicircus terrain-domain migration is implemented.
